spiritgiven.comments: Well spirited game to start euros :) you guys embody a disc is never down until it's down
Great final match-up of the season
Intense well-spirited game, see you next season!
Thank you for a well spirited game, it was awesome to see how both teams could raise the level and we're looking forward to seeing you next season
You were a lovely opponent to play our first euros quarters against, thanks for playing with intensity without compromising on spirit.

As discussed in the spirit circle after a good first half we felt the spirit really deteriorated. We felt you made a lot of calls to gain an advantage and weren't willing to change your mind after hearing our perspective. We also felt in some instances your we're not clear  on the definition of the rule being called. We acknowledge that the communication from our side could have been calmer and thank you for improving on this. We also felt there was some poor self-control on the sideline.

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for the improvement. We like your positive attitude and your cheering, but we missed in some situations your self control.

We made a lot of dangerous play calls, but the other team never accepted our prospective neither our definition of it wich is the one in the rouls. Attitude during calls was nervous and not prone to listen to the opponent. Most of the time there were also comments from the side line and not nice answers during calls.Thanks for comunication outside the field and for sharing your prospective.
